name: Shuo Zhang
description: Shuo Zhang is a PhD candidate at New York University working on human-in-the-loop simulation, multimodal sensing, and autonomous driving.

education.degree: PhD Candidate · Transportation Systems / Human Factors

projects.name: DuoRoad
projects.title: Bringing drivers and VR workers into one shared road environment
projects.description: A dual-participant simulation platform for studying driver–worker interaction in safety-critical road scenarios, with human motion, gaze, vehicle sensing, and CARLA–SUMO co-simulation.
projects.alt: DuoRoad research overview showing a VR worker, driving interface, and multimodal sensing

projects.name: WZDrive
projects.title: Learning driving trajectories in roadway work zones
projects.description: Human-in-the-loop driving data and trajectory prediction in work zones. The dataset captures 1,183 trajectories from 33 drivers across six scenario conditions and three work-zone configurations.
projects.alt: WZDrive demonstration with work-zone driving scenes, recorded signals, and trajectory prediction

projects.name: WZ-Plan
projects.title: A work-zone testbed for reinforcement learning-based motion planning
projects.description: A configurable CARLA–SUMO testbed with six scenario families for training and evaluating a PPO motion planner with a structured spatial-temporal scene encoder.
projects.alt: Six WZ-Plan roadway work-zone scenarios for evaluating autonomous vehicle motion planning

publications.title: VR-WISE: VR based work zone immersive simulation with eye tracking and biometric sensors for capturing driver’s awareness
publications.details: Proceedings of the 17th International Conference on Automotive User Interfaces and Interactive Vehicular Applications, pp. 69–79.

publications.title: Improving work zone safety: Integrating VR-CARLA co-simulation and eye tracking for behavior analysis of drivers around work zones
Work Zone Safety: Benchmarking Studies between Virtual Reality-based Traffic Co-simulation Platform and Real Work-Zones
publications.details: 3rd ICRA Future of Construction Workshop, pp. 29–32.

news.text: Invited presentation on a VR-based dual-user driving simulation platform at New York City’s Vision Zero program.
